notes: Modified cash basis school district. Governmental figures from the Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p3). The General Fund column there combines the General, Depreciation, Employee Benefit and Student Fee fund schedules. Transfers between General and Other Governmental Funds (150,000 printed 8000 lines plus 250,000 hidden) net to zero in the Total column, so top-level transfers_in/out are null. Beginning/ending cash is the fund balance (cash) roll-forward: 4,274,820 + 6,652,336 - 6,540,273 = 4,386,883. School Nutrition and Activities are in governmental funds, so no business-type funds. Balance sheet (attempt 3): Statement of Assets and Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis, Total Governmental Funds column (p5), whose totals equal the government-wide net position (p2); fund balance by classification (user rule 2026-10-27). Detail: all fund budget-and-actual schedules (General p6-9, Depreciation p11, Employee Benefit p12, Activities p13, School Nutrition p14, Special Building p15, QCPU p16, Student Fee p17); only lines with a 2025 actual are listed; blank-actual budget-only lines skipped. In the General Fund schedule, expenditure lines are by function code only (object not shown, so detail_category not itemized); 2410 Office of the Principal is printed under the 2300 heading but is function School Administration (matches p3 School administration 289,549). 4300 Architecture and engineering and the Depreciation Fund 'Other' 69,651 are Building and Grounds, since p3 Operation and maintenance of plant 598,250 = 503,460 + 1,726 + 14,933 + 8,480 + 69,651. State receipts 2,883,307 (p3) split (attempt 3) using the fund schedules: Property Tax Credit 1,772,010, Homestead Exemption 57,486, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 9,237 (9,053 General + 184 Special Building), state aid 1,044,574 (rest of General Fund state sources + Nutrition state reimbursements 819). HIDDEN TRANSFERS (attempt 2): the p9 General Fund schedule lines less the 8000 lines total 6,031,633 but the p3 General Fund column less the Depreciation Fund (226,636) is 5,781,633, a 250,000 gap equal to the Depreciation Fund (200,000, p11) and Employee Benefit Fund (50,000, p12) transfers from the General Fund, which are not printed as lines in the General schedule. Split: 2710 Vehicle operation 274,894 -> spending 224,894 (matches p3 Student transportation) + other financing -50,000; 4700 Building improvements 100,000 -> spending 0 + other financing -100,000 (p3 General capital outlay 156,985 is the Depreciation Fund's only); the remaining 100,000 is inside the instruction lines (p3 Instruction 3,960,673 vs lines 4,060,673) with no line identified, so a -100,000 contra instruction line plus a -100,000 other financing line were added. General Fund expenditure items now sum to 5,781,633 (ties to p3 less Depreciation Fund); with other financing of -400,000 (150,000 printed + 250,000 hidden) the total is 6,181,633 = printed schedule total (p9). The matching positive transfers are recorded once each in the Depreciation (200,000) and Employee Benefit (50,000) schedules. Activities Fund only prints one disbursement line, no per-account schedule. Student support services 555,276 (p3) split by column: General 318,641 support services; Other Governmental 236,635 = Activities Fund disbursements (p13) as student activities. Read pages 1-17 of 17.
